controllers.OneShot: R4 first 20 steps, observations 0..19, 7.5 mm inclusive R4 decision at t20, frozen afterward; exact previous rule.
controllers.Online: Same t20 rule as OneShot; rolling decisions every 4 steps t24..80; 6.5/8.5 mm hysteresis, frozen afterward.
controllers.R1: Frozen H4, always new prediction and action index 0.
controllers.initial_switch_counting: Count a t20 change from the R4 warm-up as a switch; distinguish it from subsequent switches and post-change detection.

environment.success_rule: existing lift >= 0.10 m sustained for >= 5 steps

estimator.input: noisy cube XY only, observation indices 3:5
estimator.switch_execution: At decision t after action t-1, consume completed old chunk then replan from observation t with new interval. Always start fresh at action index 0, including R1-to-R4. No extra inference at terminal states.
estimator.window_at_decision_t: observation indices t-20 through t-1 inclusive; exclude current observation t

evaluation.run_order: model seed, profile, controller; ascending evaluation seed
evaluation.trace: First20 action/observation prefix hashes for pairing; detailed per-decision records for all episodes. Predetermined first seed in each phase has full trace.

gates: All existing and new tests plus syntax checks
All 960 smoke episodes, pairing, legacy/prefix equivalence, window/timing checks and stationarity pass before Calibration
All 14400 Calibration episodes, integrity and stationarity pass before Final
Complete 48000 Final episodes and full integrity audit before outcome analysis
hypotheses: Online may help clean-to-noisy by switching to R1.
Online may recover efficiency and possibly success noisy-to-clean by returning to R4.
Constant conditions may preserve prior behavior with few switches.
Delay, estimation error and model heterogeneity may offset benefits.

noise.implementation: Reuse make_noise_schedule(seed,1.0,20261106,160); float32 base[absolute step] multiplied by float32 profile sigma. Shape (161,2), SeedSequence([noise_seed,evaluation_seed]), NumPy PCG64. Perturb only observed cube and relative XY. Never modify physics.

outcomes.primary: Online minus OneShot equally weighted over 3 models x 2 dynamic profiles; no constant profiles in primary.
secondary: Online vs OneShot constant clean/noisy separately
Online vs R1 and R4 all profiles and per dynamic profile
Estimate error vs RMS injected sigma within each window, transition vs post-change-only windows
Bidirectional switches, appropriate-switch delay, missing and unnecessary switches
Inference calls/time, wall time, decisions, steps under each interval

research_questions: Detect changes in observation noise from noisy observations only?
Improve success over OneShot under both dynamic profiles?
Recover R4 efficiency when observations become reliable?
How do effects, harmful transitions and cost vary across three frozen policies?

stationarity_gate.material_failure: Any Online decision window or OneShot initial window exceeding 1 mm XY during smoke or Calibration fails the gate; no Final. Also diagnose corresponding windows of fixed policies.
stationarity_gate.metric: Maximum pairwise Euclidean XY displacement of true cube within each 20-observation window. Also report pairwise XYZ displacement, clean-position variance and maximum displacement from first sample.
stationarity_gate.reason: Reuse prior 1 mm stationarity tolerance, now for every estimation window. Cube XYZ movement reported separately because estimator measures XY.

statistics.exact_tests: Two-sided exact McNemar in each fixed model/profile. Holm over six dynamic Online-vs-OneShot primary component tests; separate Holm family of six constant Online-vs-OneShot tests; 12 tests for Online-vs-R1 and 12 for Online-vs-R4. No pooled independent-policy significance test.
statistics.paired_arithmetic: Online successes minus baseline successes must equal beneficial minus harmful; preserve all discordant pairs.
statistics.paired_bootstrap: Use same sampled position indices jointly across models, profiles and controllers. Primary averages six fixed-model/profile effects. Intervals conditional on three frozen policies.
statistics.seed_descriptives: For each model average its two dynamic effects; report mean, median, sample SD, min/max and direction consistency across three models.
statistics.timing: Descriptive under uncontrolled hardware load; report calls separately.

status: preregistered before any new smoke, Calibration or Final rollout
stopping: Preserve evidence and stop on corruption, duplicate/missing/unordered rows, schema/hash/config mismatch.
Stop before Final on material stationarity failure in smoke/Calibration; never repair estimator or move decision cutoff to obtain favorable results.
No extra profiles, thresholds, architectures, training or controller candidates.
Exclusive study writer lock; resumable fsync CSV rows; never overwrite completed outputs.
Honor STOP_AFTER_CELL at complete cell boundary; hard cutoff 2026-11-14 23:59:59 America/Denver, stop append-safely before further episode.
If stopped early, report exact counts, withhold Final performance analysis and clearly label unavailable deliverables.
study: Phase-limited online uncertainty-aware replanning under dynamic observation noise

switch_diagnostics.desired_intervals: For diagnostic labeling only, 0 mm -> R4, 10 mm -> R1.
switch_diagnostics.detection_delay: First actual switch at or after t40 entering the desired post-change interval, minus40; separately count already-correct-at40 and never-switched. Also report first decision selecting correct interval after40 regardless of a switch.
switch_diagnostics.harmful: Paired baseline-success/Online-failure; associational only, cannot attribute to one switch without matched counterfactual branch.
switch_diagnostics.unnecessary: Actual switch after t20 whose new interval disagrees with current nominal sigma label. Not a causal outcome attribution. Initial warm-up switch reported separately.
